caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a brownish, rusted metal tool with a pronounced hook and a pointed end, attached to a cylindrical wooden handle. The hook extends upward and curves sharply, ending in a sharp, angled point. The metal section appears to be mounted over the end of the wooden handle, which is shown at the left side of the image, exhibiting a rough, slightly splintered texture in hues of tan and light brown. The pointed end of the tool, on the right side, continues in a straight line and tapers to a sharp metallic tip. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are small handwritten notations below and to the lower right of the image.
title: Peavy
